cost_clock_components.scope: This separate final source/hash readback, in-memory syntax validation and receipt assembly only; prior manual source reading and this receipt write have no complete measured clock.

limits: Static source review, not an executed snapshot preparation or promotion. Actual preparation and remote publication require their own receipts.
The promotion driver is reviewed separately by the evidence agent.
No successful future release job, final-author CI or future PDF identity is claimed.
preparation_review: Explicit unique canonical repository-relative selection is limited to R122 and named R122 workflow files. Absolute paths, parent traversal, backslashes, .git components and symlink path components are rejected.

The observed source parent is recorded by exact commit SHA. Explicit-path ls-tree metadata supplies base blob identity and executable-bit mode; unchanged bytes and modes are excluded. Changed/new members retain exact native bytes, standard Git blob identity and base identity.

Sorted members use a fixed1980 ZIP timestamp, fixed POSIX regular-file mode and fixed DEFLATE level9. Archive/member order and metadata are deterministic within the declared compression runtime; cross-zlib-version compressed-byte identity is not asserted.

The corrected complete-input closure check and explicit ZIP readback establish lossless native bytes and Git executable-bit modes for the declared snapshot. Fixed-size180KiB chunks carry individual size/SHA256 records plus the full archive size/SHA256; promotion must independently verify their concatenation and base guards.

The exact immutable freeze inventory SHA256 is checked before and after preparation. Any selected frozen scientific member is checked against its existing frozen SHA256. Unselected native scientific files are never written by this helper; full scientific closure remains the separate frozen verifier responsibility.

Selected native inputs and Git refs are read-only. Only exclusive new administrative transport paths and a temporary archive are written. No solver, state draw, actor fit, statistical reanalysis or service timing is called.
release_and_ci_pdf_gate_review: The release driver guards the inspector source and all actual document/graphic dependencies against the event source commit, invokes the inspector after a strict four-document build, and explicitly checks its successful status, empty physical-boundary exception list and unique eight-page inclusion record.

The inspector requires eight actual included pages, exact whitespace-normalized source plotting text in order and matching page sizes. It checks the resulting PDF hashes against the current build and rechecks them after Poppler rendering.

The final-author CI invokes the same inspector after its own fresh strict build, so missing, placeholder or mismatched catalogue pages fail that invocation. Both workflows install pinned PyMuPDF1.26.6 and Pillow12.3.0 plus Poppler.
These gates validate text/page geometry and actual inclusion; they do not assert pixel identity of every drawing or replace the separately retained selected-page visual review.
resolved_findings: Every selected file is now bound before the unchanged-file skip. Closure rechecks native byte length, SHA256 and executable-bit Git mode for changed and unchanged selections, and rechecks the frozen inventory hash.

The prepared ZIP is reopened and each declared member is decompressed and matched against exact member names, byte lengths, SHA256 hashes and executable-bit modes before chunking; ZIP read also checks member CRC.
